summary: Victory Capital filed an 8-K updating its previously announced August 25, 2026 agreement to acquire First Eagle from GC Ferry Parent, L.P. Base purchase price is $7.03 billion, subject to debt-like adjustments, paid via cash, new Victory common stock equal to 4.9% of post-issuance shares, and a new Series B non-voting convertible preferred; share consideration is valued at $2 billion using a $116.26 per-share price. A definitive proxy was filed October 16, 2026. Two New York Supreme Court stockholder suits (Wright, Taylor) challenge the deal, creating disclosure-litigation overhang ahead of the vote.
